title: Surya Brasil cosmetics company is founded.
text: Surya Brasil is a privately held company based in Brazil that sells natural cosmetics.

title: Fernando Henrique Cardoso is inaugurated as the 34th President of Brazil.
text: Fernando Henrique Cardoso, also known by his initials FHC (Brazilian Portuguese: ), is a Brazilian sociologist, professor, and politician who served as the 34th president of Brazil from 1 January 1995 to 1 January 2003. He was the first Brazilian president to be reelected for a subsequent term.

title: An armed conflict between the Landless Workers' Movement and military police leaves ten dead in Corumbiara, Rondônia.
text: The Landless Workers' Movement is a social movement in Brazil aimed at land reform. Inspired by Marxism, it is the largest such movement in Latin America, with an estimated informal membership of 1.5 million across 23 of Brazil's 26 states.

title: The bishop of the Universal Church, Sérgio von Helder, kicks a statue of Our Lady of Aparecida, the country's patron saint; during two programs on Rede Record.
text: Our Lady of Aparecida Portuguese: Nossa Senhora Aparecida or Nossa Senhora da Conceição Aparecida) is a title of the Blessed Virgin Mary associated with the Immaculate Conception. Her image, a dark clay statue, is widely venerated by Brazilian Catholics, who consider her as the principal patroness of Brazil.
